additions.description: PUT /api/user allows updating username and email without uniqueness validation
additions.reasoning: The specification requires username and email to be unique and returns 400 on duplicates during user creation, but the code allows updating username and email without checking for uniqueness, potentially violating uniqueness constraints.

additions.description: PUT /api/user allows updating password, bio, and image fields
additions.reasoning: The specification requires updating bio and image, but does not explicitly require password update via PUT /api/user. The code supports password update here, which is an addition.

additions.description: GET /api/articles/{slug} returns empty object {} when article not found
additions.reasoning: The specification states that GET after deletion returns 200 with empty object {} instead of 404. This behavior is an implementation detail not explicitly required by the specification.

additions.description: DELETE /api/articles/{slug} deletes all comments of the article before deleting the article
additions.reasoning: The specification does not require deleting comments when deleting an article. The code deletes comments explicitly before deleting the article.
The specification requires status 200 on comment deletion but does not specify the response body. The code returns a JSON object with status 'ok', which is an addition.

additions.description: GET /api/articles supports filtering by author username
additions.reasoning: The specification requires filtering by author username on GET /api/articles, which is implemented in code. This is not an addition but a required feature, so no gap here.

additions.description: GET /api/articles supports pagination with limit and offset query parameters
additions.reasoning: The specification requires pagination support on article listing, which is implemented in code. This is required, so no addition.
The specification requires a feed endpoint /api/articles/feed that returns articles from followed users with pagination and articlesCount, but the code does not implement this endpoint.

omissions.description: POST /api/users does not return 400 with message 'Username and email must be unique' on duplicate username or email
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires 400 status and message 'Username and email must be unique' on duplicate username or email during user creation, but the code returns 422 with separate error messages for username and email.

omissions.description: POST /api/users/login returns 201 on successful login, but specification expects 201; code matches spec
omissions.reasoning: No omission here; code matches spec.

omissions.description: PUT /api/articles/{slug} does not prevent non-owners from updating articles
omissions.reasoning: Specification notes a security vulnerability that any user can update any article, but does not require access control. The code does not restrict updates to owners, so no omission.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/articles/{slug} does not prevent non-owners from deleting articles
omissions.reasoning: Specification notes security vulnerability but does not require restriction. Code matches spec.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles supports filtering by tag query parameter
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires filtering articles by tag via query parameter 'tag', but code does not implement filtering by tag.
Specification requires GET /api/articles/feed to return articles from followed users with pagination, but code does not implement this endpoint.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles/{slug} does not return 404 when article not found, returns empty object instead
omissions.reasoning: Specification expects 200 with empty object for deleted articles, but for non-existent articles generally 404 is expected. Code returns empty object for missing article, which may be an omission if spec expects 404 for non-deleted missing articles.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/articles/{slug} returns 200 with empty object on success, but specification expects 200 with empty object; code matches spec
POST /api/articles/{slug}/comments does not validate presence of comment body
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires comment body in POST /comments, but code does not validate that body is non-empty.

omissions.description: DELETE /api/articles/{slug}/comments/{id} does not verify comment ownership before deletion
omissions.reasoning: Specification does not require ownership check, but security best practice would require it. Code deletes comment if it belongs to article regardless of author.
Specification mentions DELETE /api/users/{email} to delete user but code does not implement this endpoint.

omissions.description: GET /api/profiles/{username} does not return 400 when user tries to follow/unfollow themselves
omissions.reasoning: Code returns 400 with message 'followerId and followingId cannot be equal' when following/unfollowing self, matching spec, so no omission.

omissions.description: GET /api/articles does not support filtering by multiple tags or combined filters
omissions.reasoning: Specification requires filtering by tagList and author separately, but code only supports author filtering, missing tag filtering.

omissions.description: Article created and updated timestamps are set correctly, but no explicit test for @BeforeUpdate hook updating updated timestamp
omissions.reasoning: Code updates updated_at on article update, matching spec requirement.
